note: Model names and releases change quickly. Check vendor pages for current details before you decide.

cards.title: Frontier releases arrive monthly
cards.body: In the past two weeks: OpenAI GPT-6.2 (Astra and Sol), Google Gemini 4, Anthropic Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, Alibaba Qwen4-Max, Meta Muse Ember. Learn to compare models on your own tasks instead of memorising names.

cards.title: Agents are the default way to work
cards.body: Coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity) plan, edit, test and open pull requests. Google moved Gemini CLI users to Antigravity in June 2026.

cards.title: Open agent standards consolidated
cards.body: MCP (tools), A2A (agent-to-agent), Agent Skills, AGENTS.md and Open Responses now sit under the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, which hosted 10 projects by 22 Oct 2026.

cards.title: Open models are close behind
cards.body: Qwen, NVIDIA Nemotron, Moonshot Kimi and Mistral (Large 4, Oct 2026) ship capable open-weight models you can run or fine-tune yourself.

cards.title: EU AI Act: what is live
cards.body: Most transparency duties (Article 50) and Commission enforcement of the general-purpose AI rules start 2 Aug 2026; the GPAI duties themselves began in Aug 2025. The Digital Omnibus deferred high-risk duties to 2 Dec 2027 (standalone) and 2 Aug 2028 (embedded products).

cards.title: Agent security is a core skill
cards.body: Agents read emails, repos and web pages, so hostile text can steer them. Prompt injection, tool permissions and MCP security are now everyday engineering topics.

student: Pick one coding agent and one research assistant; compare them weekly
Learn to verify AI output: sources, tests, your own reasoning
Build one agent project and write evals for it
nontech: Delegate multi-step tasks to an agent, then review the result
Package your best prompts as reusable skills or Projects
Know your organisation's data, privacy and AI Act obligations
tech: Context engineering: what the model sees, remembers and forgets
Evals and regression tests for every LLM feature
MCP, Agent Skills and agent security (prompt injection, permissions)
founder: Re-price features every quarter; model costs keep falling
Pick open standards (MCP, A2A) to avoid lock-in
Build evals and a compliance checklist before you scale
